architecture: Extract unchanged FactFrames source grounds first; bounded deterministic F IDs retain exact span/edition provenance. Generate one obligation-to-frame selection plan, then one complete prose draft constrained to those selected grounds. Validate plan IDs, obligation coverage and budgets; independently require every full generated claim's parsed semantics to be proved by grounds selected for its obligation. No same-model audit or NLI approval. Unknown clauses fail closed, never rewrite prose or output canned answers.
generation: One greedy CPU6-thread plan call up to128tokens and one greedy prose call up to320tokens per new question, maximum448 of512 allowed autoregressive tokens;4096context each call. If no source frames or malformed/withheld plan, no prose generation. No retries, prompt/seed search or old matrix inference.
limits: At most32 source grounds,8 selected per obligation,4 obligations,8claims and8refs. Existing source sentence window1200characters and6passages unchanged. No new parser patterns. Literal source facts and plans are not generated answer success.
checks: Preserve all prior143 source-frame results as deterministic replay regressions; new24questions across6topics include4absent. Require zero unsupported final eligible and all4absent withheld; at least one supported complete useful new generated answer for a positive experiment. Otherwise report negative; no unmatched-case improvement claim. Every final claim requires builder source inspection with independent review pending. Missing/changed models/runs/plans and corrupt namespace/cancellation must fail.
limitations: Known finite semantic parser can still reject correct paraphrases and cannot extract some topics. Plan selection is fallible relevance, not entailment or complete obligation proof. This isolates plan-before-prose without extending case-specific grammar. Do not repeat failed wording loops if usefulness stays inadequate; document the boundary. No production model/admission or services changes.
